0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and the Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Heat hosting. Miami is missing Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), and Pelle Larsson (illness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery, out) and Rocco Zikarsky (undisclosed, day-to-day and a game-time decision). The Heat lost both meetings with the Timberwolves last season, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance of winning.
